title: Basic cabinet, ok for price
text: Basic cabinet, ok for price. This 1 door cabinet was relatively easy to assemble. It’s not solid wood, but a press board, or particle board. Something akin to walmart quality. The dark brown is really attractive and easy to clean. For the price you might be able to find something a bit sturdier but there’s nothing wrong with this at all.
